gaps.quote: I laid out the signmaking template across my board to see how long the name was, in this case "Alexanders" wound up being 24.5".
gaps.what: The build needs a physical signmaking template and template guides (steps[0], steps[1]) that appear in neither materials nor tools; and the cut length (24 1/2) is specific to the example name, with no way given to compute it for another name beyond laying out the template.
